(Japanese: '''三闘将''' ''The Three Generals'') is the 59th chapter of the [[Pokémon RéBURST]] manga.

==Plot==
{{Incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* [[Amu]], [[Rovy]], and [[Ganku]] face against [[Kigyan]], [[Lukov]], and [[Toga]], emerging victorious in the process.
* Gerubu sends the Three Generals after [[Ryouga]]'s group.
* Ryouga prepares to activate the Compass of Light before being interrupted by Amu.
* Amu sends Ryouga flying to personally fight him while Rovy and Ganku stay to fight [[Karuta]] and [[Rug]].
